method: synthetic session + native SGR blocks + QEMU-agent screenshots + UIA terminal rect + per-row dominant color
limitations: OS screen capture, not the application QImage grab required by #126

sgr_carry.protocol: SGR 31;44 set before switch and kept; per-phase background-only and reverse-only space bands
sgr_carry.interpretation: 1049h and 1049l neither reset nor restore the current SGR attributes in the conhost+ConPTY+WindTerm pipeline observed here.

alt_style_restore.protocol: SGR 31;44 on main, 32;45 inside alternate, then 1049l and draw without resetting
alt_style_restore.interpretation: 1049h saves the attribute state at entry, alternate-screen changes do not leak back, and 1049l restores the entry-time attributes.
